model.admitted: true exactly when outcome is satisfied

validation_precedence: raw bytes: size, fatal UTF-8, BOM rejection, strict JSON syntax, duplicate keys, canonical safe integers, Unicode scalars, and depth
root object, required profile, profile value, required root fields, and root unknown fields
member and child-state record shapes, strings, and state enum values
duplicate member declarations and duplicate child-state members
unknown child-state members, then missing child-state members
mode type and enum, then mode-specific k presence, absence, type, and inclusive range
total pure evaluation of a valid snapshot

semantics.all_success: satisfied iff every member is success; unsatisfiable if any member is failure or cancelled; otherwise waiting
semantics.any_success: satisfied if any member is success; unsatisfiable iff every member is terminal and none is success; otherwise waiting
semantics.k_of_n_success: satisfied iff success count is at least k; unsatisfiable iff success count plus open count is less than k; otherwise waiting
semantics.all_terminal: satisfied iff open count is zero; otherwise waiting; it is never unsatisfiable
semantics.evidence: one fact per member, sorted by code then member using Unicode scalar ordering
semantics.ordering: members and child_states are semantic sets; their input permutations cannot change output bytes

invariants: child_states has exactly one record for every member and no extras
all valid scenarios yield one total outcome and sorted evidence
admitted is true iff outcome is satisfied
the evaluator is a pure function and never mutates supplied input
JavaScript and Python canonical projections must be byte-identical
non_claims: no lifecycle transition, cancellation action, recovery, retry, or task-state authority
no execution, scheduling, dispatch, transport, delivery, receipt, acknowledgement, or side effect
no replay, idempotency key, deduplication, persistence, database, event log, or cache
no time, deadline, clock, lease, authority, quorum, weighted voting, policy, or authorization
no identity proof, authentication, credential, signature, trust, consensus, runtime, or provider behavior
no named-client capability, production interoperability, merge, publication, deployment, activation, or release claim
bom_policy: A leading UTF-8 BOM is rejected as MALFORMED_JSON in both witnesses.

evidence_layers.fuzz_differential: deterministic JS/Python rejection, Unicode, permutation, and generated-scenario parity

k_type_policy: JSON floats are rejected during strict parsing as NON_CANONICAL_INTEGER. For parsed values, non-safe-integer k values including booleans and strings reject as K_OUT_OF_RANGE.
